title: Shadow Experiments API Contract (Console backend) — draft v0.3
content:
Draft API contract for Shadow Experiments surfaced in Redwood Console.

Audience: Console backend + Console UI + SDK enablement.
Non-goal: This is not the data-plane policy API (owned by control plane). This is the Console-facing API that creates/queries shadow experiments and their results.

Status: DRAFT v0.3 (stabilizing naming + pagination + RBAC). Expect changes after telemetry schema v1 and scoring pipeline are finalized.

========================================
1) Terminology / data model (Console view)
========================================
Shadow Experiment: a named configuration that mirrors a sampled subset of production requests from a control route/variant to one or more shadow targets, then scores outputs asynchronously.

Key objects:
- ShadowExperiment: config + lifecycle metadata
- ShadowExperimentRun: a time-bounded execution window for an experiment (ex: “dogfood week 1”, “canary v2”) used for comparing aggregates.
- QualityAggregate: time-series or windowed stats per metric comparing control vs shadow variants.
- Example: sampled request/response pairs (redacted) + scoring artifacts to support drilldowns.

A note on ownership: The actual routing behavior is enforced by data plane/control plane. Console API should:
- Validate user intent + enforce RBAC
- Create an experiment record
- Write/control-plane bindings (either directly or via an internal integration call)
- Provide read APIs over scoring + telemetry-derived aggregates

========================================
2) API principles
========================================
2.1 Base path + auth
- Base path (internal): /console/v1
- Auth: Redwood Console session -> gateway issues bearer token; service-to-service includes internal auth (mTLS + service identity).
- Tenant isolation is mandatory for all reads/writes.

2.2 Idempotency
- POST create supports Idempotency-Key header.
- Starting a run supports Idempotency-Key.

2.3 Pagination
- Cursor pagination everywhere for list endpoints.
- Query params: page_size (default 50, max 200), cursor
- Response includes: next_cursor (empty if end)

2.4 Filtering
- Filters should be additive and safe for cardinality.
- Avoid arbitrary tag filters that can explode query plans.

2.5 Consistency / freshness
- Aggregates are computed asynchronously; API must expose:
  - computed_through (timestamp)
  - scoring_lag_seconds (p50/p95 optional)
  - partial_data flag when pipelines are catching up

2.6 RBAC
We need a clear mapping from Console roles to actions.
Proposed roles (existing patterns):
- org_admin: all actions
- project_admin: all actions scoped to project
- route_editor: can create/modify experiments attached to routes they can edit
- viewer: read-only

Additional constraint: Access to Examples (raw-ish content even after redaction) is stricter.
- examples: require “quality_data_viewer” capability (enterprise tenants may restrict further)

========================================
3) Object schemas (text form)
========================================
3.1 ShadowExperiment fields (conceptual)
- experiment_id: string (rw_shx_...)
- tenant_id: string (implicit from auth context; do not accept from client)
- project_id: string
- route_id: string (route under test)
- name: string
- description: string (optional)
- status: string enum: DRAFT | ACTIVE | PAUSED | ARCHIVED
- created_at: RFC3339 timestamp
- created_by: string (user_id)
- last_modified_at: RFC3339 timestamp
- last_modified_by: string (user_id)

Configuration fields (subject to control plane validation):
- sampling_rate: number (0.0–1.0)
- sampling_mode: string enum: BERNOULLI | DETERMINISTIC_BUCKET
- bucketing_seed: string (optional; if omitted, system-generated)
- shadow_targets: list of variant refs (one or more)
  - each target ref resolves to one of:
    - model_ref: model_id + version (hosted)
    - deployment_ref: dedicated pool + model
    - policy_ref: routing policy variant
  (In the actual API response we will flatten into strings; see 4.1 examples.)

- timeouts:
  - shadow_request_timeout_ms (default 1500; max 5000)
  - enqueue_timeout_ms (default 50; max 200)

- fail_open: boolean (must be true; enforced)
- max_shadow_rps: number (optional guardrail; default unlimited but internal guardrails apply)
- headers_behavior: string enum: STRIP_ALL | PASS_THROUGH_ALLOWLIST | PASS_THROUGH_ALL
- header_allowlist: list of strings (only valid when PASS_THROUGH_ALLOWLIST)

Data handling:
- redaction_profile_id: string (defaults to “standard”) 
- retention_days: number (default 3 hosted; configurable dedicated/private; must comply with tenant policy)
- store_prompts: boolean (default false; if true, must be redacted + truncated)
- store_responses: boolean (default false; if true, must be redacted)

Scoring:
- scoring_enabled: boolean
- rubric_set_id: string (ex: “quality-v1”) 
- rubric_set_version: string (ex: “2026-02-01”) 
- metrics_bundle: string (ex: “default-v1”) 
- segment_keys_allowlist: list of strings (for safe breakdowns; ex: “region”, “request_type”, “sdk_language”)

3.2 ShadowExperimentRun fields
- run_id: string (rw_shxr_...)
- experiment_id: string
- name: string (optional; if empty, UI shows time range)
- status: string enum: RUNNING | STOPPED | FAILED
- started_at: RFC3339
- stopped_at: RFC3339 (optional)
- started_by: user_id
- stop_reason: string (optional)
- computed_through: RFC3339 (aggregates freshness)

3.3 Metric aggregate output (per metric, per variant)
We want to support both single-window deltas and time-series. v0.3 focuses on windowed aggregates with optional time buckets.

Fields:
- metric_key: string (ex: “format_adherence_rate”, “refusal_rate”, “rubric.overall_score_mean”)
- metric_display_name: string
- metric_unit: string enum: RATE | SCORE | COUNT | MS | TOKENS
- window_start: RFC3339
- window_end: RFC3339

For each comparison (shadow target vs control):
- control_n: number (sample size)
- shadow_n: number
- control_value: number
- shadow_value: number
- delta: number (shadow - control)
- delta_pct: number (optional)
- ci_level: number (default 0.95)
- ci_low: number
- ci_high: number
- p_value: number (optional; only when methodology supports)
- notes: string (optional; ex “insufficient sample size”)

3.4 Example (drilldown)
Examples are sensitive; response must be redacted and may omit prompt/response entirely depending on tenant settings.

Fields:
- example_id: string
- experiment_id: string
- run_id: string
- request_fingerprint: string (hashed)
- request_received_at: RFC3339 (rounded to minute for privacy)
- route_id: string
- request_type: string enum: CHAT | COMPLETIONS | EMBEDDINGS (embeddings likely v2)

Content (may be null/empty strings depending on policy):
- prompt_preview: string (truncated, redacted)
- control_output_preview: string (truncated, redacted)
- shadow_output_preview: string (truncated, redacted)

Scoring summary:
- metric_summaries: string (single string blob in v0.3; structured later)
- flags: list of strings (ex: “format_drift”, “unsafe_content_suspected”)

========================================
4) Endpoints (contract)
========================================
NOTE: Response bodies below are illustrative. Exact JSON field casing is lower_snake_case.
We will not return nested objects in the docs; actual API returns JSON objects, but this doc uses field lists.

4.1 Create experiment
POST /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments
Headers:
- Idempotency-Key: optional string
Request body fields:
- route_id (required)
- name (required)
- description (optional)
- sampling_rate (required)
- sampling_mode (optional; default DETERMINISTIC_BUCKET)
- shadow_target_refs (required; list of strings; each string is a canonical ref)
  - examples:
    - “model:rwmdl_llama3_70b@2026-01-15:fp16”
    - “policy_variant:rwpv_abc123”
    - “dedicated_pool:rwpool_456/model:rwmdl_qwen2_72b@2026-02-01:int8”
- shadow_request_timeout_ms (optional)
- max_shadow_rps (optional)
- headers_behavior (optional)
- header_allowlist (optional; list)
- redaction_profile_id (optional)
- retention_days (optional)
- store_prompts (optional)
- store_responses (optional)
- scoring_enabled (optional; default true)
- rubric_set_id (optional)
- rubric_set_version (optional)
- metrics_bundle (optional)
- segment_keys_allowlist (optional; list)

Response: 201
- experiment_id
- project_id
- route_id
- name
- description
- status (default DRAFT)
- sampling_rate
- sampling_mode
- shadow_target_refs
- created_at
- created_by
- last_modified_at
- last_modified_by

Errors:
- 400 invalid_argument (sampling_rate out of bounds, invalid refs, header allowlist with wrong mode)
- 403 permission_denied
- 409 conflict (idempotency key reused with different payload)
- 422 unprocessable_entity (fails control-plane validation; return validation_errors string)

RBAC:
- route_editor+ for the target route

4.2 Get experiment
GET /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}
Response: 200
- all fields from create response + config flags + latest_run_id (optional)

RBAC:
- viewer+ on project

4.3 Update experiment
PATCH /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}
Request body fields (all optional):
- name
- description
- sampling_rate
- shadow_target_refs
- shadow_request_timeout_ms
- max_shadow_rps
- headers_behavior
- header_allowlist
- redaction_profile_id
- retention_days
- store_prompts
- store_responses
- scoring_enabled
- rubric_set_id
- rubric_set_version
- metrics_bundle
- segment_keys_allowlist

Constraints:
- Cannot update experiment if status == ARCHIVED.
- Updates that would violate tenant retention policy return 422.
- Some fields may be locked while ACTIVE (TBD): e.g. changing redaction/retention mid-run is risky; might require PAUSED.

Response: 200
- updated experiment

RBAC:
- route_editor+ on route, or project_admin

Audit logging:
- Must emit audit log entry for any config mutation (ENG-5417)

4.4 Change lifecycle state
POST /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}:activate
POST /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}:pause
POST /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}:archive

Semantics:
- activate: transitions DRAFT/PAUSED -> ACTIVE and attempts to apply bindings to routing.
- pause: transitions ACTIVE -> PAUSED and removes/neutralizes shadow policy binding.
- archive: transitions any -> ARCHIVED (read-only; stops routing; retains metadata)

Response: 200
- experiment_id
- status
- last_modified_at

RBAC:
- route_editor+ 

Fail-open note:
- If the control-plane binding call fails, activation returns 502/503 and status remains unchanged.

4.5 List experiments
GET /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments
Query params:
- route_id (optional)
- status (optional; can repeat)
- created_by (optional)
- updated_after (optional RFC3339)
- page_size, cursor

Response: 200
- experiments: list (each item includes: experiment_id, route_id, name, status, sampling_rate, shadow_target_refs summary, created_at, last_modified_at)
- next_cursor

RBAC:
- viewer+

4.6 Create a run (start)
POST /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}/runs
Headers:
- Idempotency-Key: optional
Request body fields:
- name (optional)

Semantics:
- Creates a run record and marks it RUNNING.
- If experiment is DRAFT, starting a run should implicitly activate (TBD). Safer default: require ACTIVE first.

Response: 201
- run_id
- experiment_id
- status (RUNNING)
- started_at
- started_by

RBAC:
- route_editor+

4.7 Stop a run
POST /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}/runs/{run_id}:stop
Request body fields:
- stop_reason (optional)

Response: 200
- run_id
- status (STOPPED)
- stopped_at

RBAC:
- route_editor+

4.8 List runs
GET /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}/runs
Query params:
- status (optional)
- started_after (optional)
- page_size, cursor

Response: 200
- runs: list (run_id, name, status, started_at, stopped_at, computed_through)
- next_cursor

RBAC:
- viewer+

4.9 Fetch aggregates (windowed)
GET /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}/aggregates
Query params:
- run_id (optional; if omitted, default to latest RUNNING else most recent STOPPED)
- window_start (optional RFC3339)
- window_end (optional RFC3339)
- granularity (optional; enum: HOUR | DAY; if omitted return single window)
- metrics (optional; comma-separated metric_keys; if omitted default bundle)
- segment_by (optional; must be in segment_keys_allowlist; single key v0.3)
- page_size, cursor (only if granularity returns many buckets; otherwise no pagination)

Response: 200
- experiment_id
- run_id
- computed_through
- scoring_lag_seconds_p50 (optional)
- scoring_lag_seconds_p95 (optional)
- partial_data (true/false)
- aggregates: list (see 3.3)
- next_cursor (optional)

RBAC:
- viewer+

Notes:
- segment_by must be a safe dimension; server enforces allowlist per experiment + global denylist (customer_id, prompt_id, raw_model_version_hash, etc).

4.10 Fetch examples (drilldown)
GET /console/v1/projects/{project_id}/shadow-experiments/{experiment_id}/examples
Query params:
- run_id (optional; defaults same as aggregates)
- metric_key (optional; filter examples related to a metric)
- outcome (optional; enum: ANY | REGRESSION | IMPROVEMENT | NEUTRAL | FAILED_SCORING)
- has_prompt (optional true/false)
- has_outputs (optional true/false)
- limit (optional; default 20; max 100)
- cursor (optional)

Response: 200
- experiment_id
- run_id
- examples: list (see 3.4)
- next_cursor

RBAC:
- Requires capability “quality_data_viewer” (in addition to viewer+). If not granted:
  - Return 403 permission_denied

Privacy:
- prompt_preview/control_output_preview/shadow_output_preview may be empty strings even when authorized if tenant has store_prompts/store_responses false.

========================================
5) RBAC matrix (initial)
========================================
Action -> Required permission
- list experiments -> viewer+
- get experiment -> viewer+
- create experiment -> route_editor+ (route edit permission)
- update experiment -> route_editor+
- activate/pause/archive -> route_editor+
- start/stop run -> route_editor+
- view aggregates -> viewer+
- view examples -> viewer+ AND quality_data_viewer

Open item: Do we require a separate permission for changing retention/store_prompts/store_responses? Security suggests yes (Marcus/Naomi). Candidate: “quality_data_admin”.

========================================
6) Error model
========================================
Standard error shape (conceptual):
- error_code: string (invalid_argument, permission_denied, not_found, conflict, rate_limited, internal, unavailable)
- message: string
- request_id: string
- details: string (optional; should avoid leaking sensitive config)

Special cases:
- 404 not_found should not reveal cross-tenant existence.
- 429 rate_limited should include retry_after_ms if available.

========================================
7) Performance / safety considerations
========================================
- Examples endpoint must be hard-capped and default to low volume.
- Aggregates queries should hit pre-aggregated tables (Telemetry-owned) and never scan raw events for long windows by default.
- Segmenting/breakdowns must enforce cardinality guardrails server-side.
- A run can be RUNNING even when scoring is lagging; surface computed_through + partial_data.

========================================
8) Compatibility with Rollouts / A-B
========================================
We need to attach experiments to rollout entities in the rollouts timeline.
Proposed fields on ShadowExperiment (not required for MVP):
- rollout_id (optional)
- rollout_variant_id (optional; which candidate this experiment is validating)

If present, UI shows “Quality signals” on the rollout page.

Open question: Do we create shadow experiments from rollouts UI by default (one per canary) or allow multiple experiments per rollout? Likely multiple.

========================================
9) Open questions / TODO
========================================
1) Activation semantics:
- Require explicit activate before start run? (leaning yes)
- What happens if ACTIVE but no run exists? We still mirror traffic, but metrics have no run_id. Option: auto-create implicit run on activation.

2) Naming of target refs:
- Do we standardize a canonical ref string format now? (preferred) or return resolved fields? SDKs want typed structures, but telemetry wants stable strings.

3) Streaming requests examples:
- Can we safely store previews for streaming outputs? Proposed: store first N chars and final chunk only; flag “streaming_partial”.

4) Retention controls:
- How do Dedicated/Private override defaults? API should reflect effective retention after policy evaluation.

5) Statistical fields:
- Which CI method are we standardizing (Wilson for rates? bootstrap for rubric means?) and do we include p_value at all in v1?

6) Multi-segment breakdowns:
- v0.3 only supports one segment_by. UI wants two-level filters eventually. Need guardrails.

7) Audit logs:
- Confirm audit log event names and minimum fields with Kevin Osei.

========================================
10) Change log
========================================
- v0.3 (2026-02-09): added lifecycle endpoints, clarified examples RBAC, added computed_through + partial_data, standardized cursor pagination.
- v0.2: initial CRUD + aggregates.
